brief.question: How does Parsec (installer C:\REA\parsec-windows.exe) structure its client, service and server/back-end, so we can rebuild a Parsec-like remote desktop client in Rust (eframe/egui) on top of the RustDesk engine, with an online registry of remote nodes and our own server?
brief.purpose: Learning / clean reimplementation for interoperability-style self-hosted remote desktop (SigmaDesk).
constraints: Static analysis only of the target
brief.done_when: A Rust eframe app in app/ builds, has --screenshot, and MECHANICS.md/mechanics.json document Parsec's architecture (endpoints, ports, services, components) with sources.

findings.statement: parsec-windows.exe is an NSIS installer carrying parsecd.exe (loader), pservice.exe (Windows service 'Parsec', auto start), teams.exe, parsec-vud.exe (virtual USB) and parsec-vdd.exe (virtual display) installers, plus the real app parsecd-150-104a.dll (sha256 8c8c4299…, entry wx_main per appdata.json). Installer options: /percomputer /shared /silent /vdd /team_computer_key= /team_id= /api_host=kessel-api.parsec.app; registers parsec:// and parsecd:// URL protocols and firewall rule for parsecd.exe.

Parsec back-end: REST API at kessel-api.<env>.parsec.app (POST /v2/auth with email,password,session_scopes[ws.host,ws.client,api.writer],host_peer_id → session; GET /v2/hosts?mode=desktop with Bearer token, polled every 20000 ms, returns data[] {players,name,peer_id,build,self,guest_access,event_name,user{name,id},team_id,has_avatar}, max 256 hosts; /me polled every 1.8–2.4 M ms; /friendships, /teams/%s/machines, /metrics). Signalling over WebSocket kessel-ws.<env>/?session_id=&role=&version=1&build=&sdk_version=0x60000 with JSON {version,action,payload{from,to,data,attempt_id}} actions offer/answer/candex(+_relay)/close/conn_update; host conn_update payload has name,desc,secret,max_players,players,public,guests[]; reconnect backoff 30 s doubling, 1 h after 50 tries. NAT traversal: STUN binding (cookie 0x2112A442) to stun.parsec.app / stun6.parsec.app port 3478, candidates STUN_RFLX/STUN_P2P, relay fallback, app_force_relay. Host UDP port = network_server_start_port or 21000+rand%2000.

Ghidra re-read: hosts list refresh 20000 ms, ×1.5 after each failure up to 60000 ms, reset on success, 429 = rate limited (FUN_18002dd60). Signal reconnect: random(t,2t), t=30000 doubling to 300000 while counter < 51, then 3600000 (FUN_1800cf9c0). Relays come from app_stun_address as 'host@port' joined by ',', max 20, default port 3478, default stun.parsec.app@3478; app_force_relay 0 off / odd all / else WAN (FUN_18009adc0, FUN_180050230). Signal actions: sdk, close, offer_relay, offer_cancel_relay, answer_relay, candex_relay (FUN_1800cee50).

Parsec account rules (Ghidra): logout = DELETE /auth/sessions (FUN_180031a60); re-confirmation = PATCH /auth/sessions/elevate {password, tfa} (FUN_18002f860); an un-confirmed session may host but must re-authenticate to connect ('Authentication Required', FUN_180030150); accounts shown as name#id; confirm e-mail POST /me/send-confirmation-email {} (FUN_18002e220); team provisioning POST /teams/%s/machines with X-Machine-Key and {name, team_guest_access:false} (FUN_180005d60).

Parsec web-link rules (Ghidra FUN_18002ad10): share link https://parsec.gg/g/<peer_id>/<ws_secret>/, ws_secret = random in [0x7fffffff, 0xffffffff] printed '%x'; 'copied' notice 10000 ms, 'invalidated' notice 5000 ms; card captions This/Your/Shared Computer or name#id. Settings 'Account' opens dash.parsec.app (FUN_1800192e0); API domain from a 6-entry environment table (FUN_18004c820); running app accepts 'peer_id=' links (FUN_180091e50).

Parsec team-computer registration (Ghidra): POST /teams/%s/machines is called from the login screen (sub_18001bc56) and its reply is parsed by FUN_180005f60. Only HTTP 201 counts; the body is {"data":{"id":"<≤64 chars>"}}; on 401 it shows the 'error' text; other failures show 'Failed request to %s. %s' with advice by code (-800 connection, 401/403 re-login, 412 re-auth, else wait). user.bin keeps session_id in a 0x41-byte buffer (FUN_1800c6220). Silent start relaunches with "app_silent=1" (FUN_1800731f0).

handoff: State: app/ builds; rebuild_check passes. Docker stack (hbbs, hbbr, sigmadesk-server) running from app/docker-compose.yml; server data volume has NO accounts yet (first account = admin). Node installer: app/deploy/install-node.ps1 + release sigmadesk.exe in app/deploy/package, served at http://10.10.3.7:21180/download/. Parsec-verified provisioning: POST /teams/<team>/machines + X-Machine-Key -> 201 {"data":{"id"}} (FUN_180005f60). 10.10.1.92 only exposes RDP 3389 (WinRM/SMB/SSH closed) so installation must be run by the person inside their RDP session; not done yet (unk_3a13d5f88d39404f). RustDesk not installed on this PC, so --connect/--get-id/--option untested (unk_3191f54973d6c672). Next: after the person installs on 10.10.1.92, check the server data for lan_ip 10.10.1.92 and test 'SigmaDesk로 제어'.
